8 انتفخ It (a thing, S, as a skin, Msb,) became inflated, or puffy; (S, A, Msb;) as also ↓ تنفّخ : (A:) also, it became swollen; i. q. وَرِمَ. (K, art. ورم.) ―
-b2- انتفخ He became inflated, or filled, by food. (L.) See 1. ―
-b3- إِنْتِفَاخُ الأَهِلَّةِ (tropical:) The bigness [or swelling] of the new moons. Occurring in a trad. respecting the signs of the last day. (L.) [See انتفج.] ―
-b4- انتفخ عَلَىَّ (assumed tropical:) [He became inflated against me; i. e.] he was angry with me. (TA.) And انتفخ لَهُ (assumed tropical:) [He behaved angrily to him]. (TA in art. زحر.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
